items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: And I got him a contract on that either. Mm-hmm. Because he wasn't going to. You know, he was on of my getting money off the Fast Downbone.

ctx.x: And he did, and also he did, what was the thing Fast Downbone did? Marty Grudin. Marty Grudin.
